adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that while the diff fixes getSubGroupsCount() at line 274-275 to handle null model, the method getSubGroupsStream(search, firstResult, maxResults) at line 256 still calls modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream() without null checking. Looking at the diff context, line 256 shows 'return getGroupModel().getSubGroupsStream(search, firstResult, maxResults);' which would still throw NPE if the group is deleted concurrently. The fix pattern applied to getSubGroupsCount() was not applied to this similar method, leaving the concurrent access bug partially unfixed.
